fields.title: 📖 The Qurʾān does not pass beyond their throats
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“They read the Qurʾān, yet it does not pass beyond their throats.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Much recitation alone is no proof of right guidance when understanding, the Sunnah and the manhaj of the Salaf are abandoned.

immutable.source: 📝 Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb az-Zakāh, Bāb: Dhikr al-Khawārij wa-ṣifātihim, Hadith Nr. 1064.
